tasks.title: Centralize changed-file classification
tasks.description: Add shared client-side diff classification for large, generated, lockfile, dependency, binary, and normally readable changed files. The classifier should expose stable per-file metadata that later reader flows can use to choose an initial file and decide whether to show a collapsed placeholder instead of rendering expensive content.
acceptanceCriteria: Normal source files are classified as readable and not collapsed by default
Lockfiles such as package-lock.json are classified as generated or dependency-heavy and collapsed by default
Files over the large-diff changed-line threshold expose a collapse reason and changed-line count
Binary files are not selected as readable source files by the default selection heuristic
Existing merge-base diff API semantics remain unchanged
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Input: parsed diff blocks and file paths. Output: reusable file metadata and selection/collapse helpers consumed by the files page and panes. Covers issue-changed-files-reader large-diff protection and lightweight file-focused reading requirements.

tasks.title: Harden the files route data boundary
tasks.description: Make /issue/:number/files explicitly handle invalid route params and all issue, diff, commits, and commit-diff query states. Direct URL loads, browser refreshes, and SPA navigation should follow the same component path and render loading, content, empty, unavailable, or recoverable error UI instead of leaving a blank React root.
acceptanceCriteria: Direct load of /issue/:number/files renders a visible page when diff data is available
Browser refresh of /issue/:number/files renders the same visible page state as SPA navigation
Invalid route params render a visible recoverable error state
Issue, diff, commits, or commit-diff API failures render a visible error state with a link or button back to the issue detail page when the issue number is known
The files route does not introduce approval, review comment, or merge actions
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the file metadata from T-001 so route success states can safely derive readable defaults without render-time exceptions. Expected touch points may include App.tsx, useQueries.ts, and API response typing only where needed for reliable page rendering.

tasks.title: Replace eager all-files initial rendering
tasks.description: Change the default reader state from rendering every parsed diff block to rendering either one sensible selected file or a lightweight summary prompt. Keep the changed-files tree visible as the orientation surface and validate any restored selection against the current parsed blocks before rendering it.
acceptanceCriteria: Initial load of a multi-file diff does not render every line of every changed file into the DOM
When a readable non-generated non-large file exists, the initial reader selects that file or otherwise shows a lightweight choose-a-file summary
When all files are generated, large, or binary, the reader shows a lightweight summary instead of rendering a full patch stream
The changed-files tree remains visible and usable before and after file selection
Missing or stale restored file selections fall back to the current readable-file heuristic or summary state
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the route/query boundary from T-002 and classification/selection helpers from T-001. The outcome is a reader view model for issue-level diffs and commit-scoped diffs rather than an all-files-first patch stream.

tasks.title: Apply collapse and header rules across reader modes
tasks.description: Use the shared classification metadata to show collapsed placeholders for large generated or dependency-heavy files across selected diff, split, raw patch, search, and full-file reading modes where applicable. Ensure each visible file has one clear file header by removing obsolete wrapper headers or making pane header ownership explicit.
acceptanceCriteria: Large generated files and lockfiles show a collapsed placeholder by default with changed-line count and a Render anyway action
Render anyway reveals the selected file content without disabling collapse protection for unrelated files
Large-diff protection applies in the default selected-file flow and in single-file, split, search, raw patch, and full-file modes where applicable
Commit-scoped reading reuses the same classification, selection, and collapse behavior as issue-level reading
Each rendered file block shows only one sticky file header
Existing merge-base diff semantics remain unchanged
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes the shared metadata from T-001, the reliable page state from T-002, and the selected-file reader model from T-003. Expected touch points include UnifiedDiffPane, SplitDiffPane, RawPatchPane, FullFilePane, DiffSearchPane, and any shared file-header or collapse placeholder component.

tasks.title: Add files page regression coverage
tasks.description: Add automated regression tests that prove the fixed route and reader behavior on realistic changed-file data. Cover direct-route rendering, refresh-equivalent initial routing, recoverable error UI, non-eager default rendering, generated or lockfile collapse with override, and duplicate-header prevention.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover direct loading /issue/:number/files with available diff data and assert the page is not blank
Tests cover refresh-equivalent routing or initial router entry behavior for the files route
Tests cover visible recoverable error UI with a path back to issue detail for route or API failures
Tests prove the initial state does not render all changed-file lines for a multi-file diff
Tests cover lockfile or generated large-diff collapse by default and Render anyway behavior
Tests assert file headers are not duplicated for a rendered file
Existing web tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Consumes all implemented behavior from T-001 through T-004. Prefer existing React/router test patterns in the web test suite and realistic fixture diffs that include a normal source file plus a large lockfile.
